high_level_description: This image captures a coastal scene on an overcast day, with a muted and somewhat somber mood due to the gray sky and lack of sunlight. The foreground features a sandy beach where waves are gently lapping onto the shore. The water appears calm but slightly choppy, with some white foam visible near the shoreline. There are patches of seaweed or similar vegetation scattered along the edge of the water. In the middle ground, there is a strip of land that separates the beach from a body of water, possibly a river or estuary.
